## 3. PROPRIETARY TERMINOLOGY DEFINITIONS

- What is an Intent Operating System?
  https://www.chatrchat.in/what-is-an-intent-operating-system
  Definition: An execution runtime that translates unstructured human intent directly into executable directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of software capabilities, bypassing manual multi-app navigation.
- What is a Robotics Operating System?
  https://www.chatrchat.in/what-is-a-robotics-operating-system
  Definition: A distributed software platform that manages communication, sensor telemetry, state estimation, motion planning, and actuator control across robotic hardware and digital twins, enabling autonomous machines to perceive environments and safely execute complex physical tasks.
- What is an AI Business OS?
  https://www.chatrchat.in/what-is-an-ai-business-os
  Definition: A unified enterprise runtime replacing siloed CRM, ERP, ATS, and messaging databases with a single real-time operating graph, shared timeline, and decision intelligence engine.
- What is SmartSession Calling?
  https://www.chatrchat.in/what-is-smartsession-calling
  Definition: A context-preserving communication session protocol that pre-warms authentication, payment, and capability discovery before and during voice/video interaction.
- What is a Universal Business Inbox?
  https://www.chatrchat.in/what-is-a-universal-business-inbox
  Definition: A consolidated operational queue that unifies customer messaging channels, voice call transcripts, team tasks, and SLA timers into a single collaborative thread view.
